author: Mogwai
title: Looking for Lead Manga Artist - The Tactician of Fire and Stone
content:
I'm looking for a lead manga artist for an ongoing series I've worked on for years.

Title: The Tactician of Fire and Stone

I have a full script and drawn storyboard finished for Chapter 1.
The initial goal is to set up a kickstarter campaign that I would promote via my Youtube channel (YOU WOULD BE PAYED FOR ANY WORK DONE PRIOR TO SAID CAMPAIGN).

The purpose of the campaign would be to fund the creation of a studio, so that you can be payed a competitive salary long term (the initial salary funded by the kickstarter, and then covered by me after the series keeps going).

The series would be structured for a monthly release. 

Art styles that I envision include the likes of Blue Lock and Bleach. I am looking for an artist skilled in sequential art, as the action I've designed is quite complex... spatial choreography and a strong sense of character/environment positioning are key.

If you'd like to know more about it (read the storyboard/script, ask me ANY questions about it), don't hesitate to DM me! You can also email me at megamogwai@gmail.com 

No strings attached! You can evaluate my work, my concept and then determine if it's something that would interest you enough to pursue it.

#manga #mangaartist #Lookingforartist #artistforhire #comicartist
budget: competitive salary / paid prior to Kickstarter
